channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: JetBlue canceling Vero Beach to JFK route in September due to low demand
item.description: JetBlue is canceling its flight route between Vero Beach Regional Airport and New York's JFK Airport, with the last flights operating on Sept. 9. item.title: Humane Society of the Treasure Coast seeks fosters and adopters during shelter renovation
item.description: The Humane Society of the Treasure Coast is calling on the community to foster or adopt animals as the organization enters phase two of a major facility renovation.

item.title: Security ramped up for World Cup final Sunday in New Jersey
item.description: Federal agents, local law enforcement, and private companies are implementing a security plan two years in the making for Sunday's World Cup final between Argentina and Spain. The match has the highest possible security designation as a Level 1 Special Event.

item.title: Argentina rallies past England 2-1 to reach World Cup final
item.description: Lionel Messi and Argentina scored twice in the final minutes to defeat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinals. The defending champions will face Spain in Sunday's final in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

item.title: Messi and Yamal to face off in World Cup final nearly two decades after iconic photo
item.description: Lionel Messi and Lamine Yamal will face each other in Sunday's World Cup final, nearly two decades after photographer Joan Monfort captured images of a teenage Messi bathing baby Yamal in a Barcelona charity photo shoot.

item.title: MLB restricts dugout iPad use to prevent AI from making game decisions
item.description: Major League Baseball made custom tabs on dugout iPads inaccessible to teams starting Wednesday night to prevent artificial intelligence from helping make in-game decisions. The tablets have access to video and league-provided data.

item.title: Flip City gymnasts from Treasure Coast earn national top 15 finish, qualify for Junior Olympics
item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month and qualified for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.title: Downtown Delray Beach launches Wellness Pass with free fitness classes and spa discounts
item.description: The Delray Beach Downtown Development Authority created a mobile pass offering free classes and wellness deals for July and August.

item.title: Delray Beach dance studio plans Bridgerton-style masquerade gala July 24
item.description: Fred Astaire Dance Studios Delray Beach is celebrating nine years with a themed anniversary gala and launching new Saturday dance classes.

item.title: Palm Beach Zoo extends Kids Free promotion through August 10
item.description: Palm Beach Zoo has extended its popular Kids Free promotion and announced the return of adults-only Wild Night Out events.

item.title: Declassified records show Chinese actor downloaded Florida voter registration data in 2022
item.description: Newly released White House intelligence records show a Chinese cyber actor downloaded publicly available Florida voter registration information from commercial websites in 2022.

item.title: Democratic Rep. Nixon gets September trial date on Capitol sit-in charges
item.description: Florida state Rep. Angie Nixon will stand trial the week of Sept. 21 on misdemeanor charges stemming from her May protest outside Gov. Ron DeSantis' Capitol office.

item.title: Defense Secretary Hegseth backs Blue Angels low-altitude Pensacola beach flyover
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is defending a Blue Angels jet that flew so low over a Pensacola beach Wednesday that chairs and tents went flying and sand kicked up.

item.title: Florida gubernatorial candidate Fishback faces court fight over residency requirement
item.description: Republican gubernatorial candidate James Fishback will defend his eligibility to remain in the primary next week as an opponent challenges whether he meets Florida's seven-year residency requirement.

item.title: Vindman raises $8.5 million in Florida U.S. Senate race, expands fundraising lead
item.description: Democratic U.S. Senate candidate Alex Vindman raised $8.5 million during the second quarter, pushing his total receipts above $16 million in the race for Marco Rubio's former seat.

item.title: Pensacola beachgoer calls Blue Angels low flyover a once-in-a-lifetime experience
item.description: Florida beachgoer Alexandra Belcher said the Blue Angels flyover in Pensacola this week was a blessing to witness, despite the jet flying so low that sand kicked up and chairs went flying.

item.title: Martin County faces $2.1 billion transportation funding gap as needs outpace available money
item.description: Martin County is facing a $2.1 billion transportation funding shortfall, and the gap between what the county needs and what it can afford could shape how residents get around for decades.

item.title: FDOT to Hold Public Workshops on Willoughby Boulevard Improvement Study
item.description: The Florida Department of Transportation will hold two public workshops to discuss proposed improvements along Willoughby Boulevard between Monterey Road and U.S. 1 in Martin Count

item.description:
